articles.title: Brookfield to Invest Up to $600 Million in ACME’s Green Fuels Projects in India and Oman
articles.summary: Brookfield Asset Management (NYSE:BAM) has agreed to invest up to $600 million in India’s ACME Cleantech Ventures to support the development and construction of green ammonia and green methanol projects, the companies announced on Thursday. The investment marks Brookfield’s entry into the region’s low-carbon fuels sector and will be made through its Brookfield Global Transition Fund strategy.
